findings.element: Events tab › Held row 'Plate seconds (B-grade)' › Reason 'Item not matched · Match it' (and Overview Held count)
findings.finding: After the user matches the product, the Held event keeps saying 'Item not matched · Match it' and its link leads to a Mappings page that says 'Every product is matched.', with no cue that the change still needs Retry.
findings.user_impact: Users who fix the mapping believe the held stock change will go out on its own, or get stuck bouncing between Match it and an all-matched Mappings page, so the +12 adjustment never reaches Shopify.
findings.suggested_fix: Once the item is matched, change the Held reason to 'Matched — retry to send' with a Retry action on that row, and show a 'Retry 1 held change' prompt in the Mappings end state and next to the Held count on the Overview.

evidence.action: State 2 · Store needs fixes → My ceramic plates › Match products → map Plate seconds to 'Plate seconds (B-grade) · PL-SEC' (toast 'QuickBooks item mapped.', '5 of 5 matched · Every product is matched.') → Back to overview → Events tab → click 'Match it' on the Held row
evidence.observed: Overview still shows Held 1 with no cue; Events row still reads 'Held · Item not matched · Match it'; Match it opens Mappings showing 'Every product is matched.' with only 'Back to overview'. The event only becomes Applied after the user finds and clicks 'Retry held and failed' (toast '1 held change sent.').

findings.element: Shopify stores card badge 'Ready' + removal of the setup banner, with Sync › Enable in the middle column
findings.finding: When the last required fix is done, the store gets a 'Ready' badge and the page's only call-to-action banner disappears, but sync is still Disabled and the required next step (Enable) sits in a different column with no pointer from the card the user just worked in.
findings.user_impact: Mirrors the Import → Sync drop-off (KF-2): users read 'Ready' plus a cleared banner as 'done' and leave with sync off, so no stock changes are ever sent.
findings.suggested_fix: While sync is Disabled, replace the banner with 'My ceramic plates is ready — enable sync to start sending changes' with an inline Enable button, and add the same prompt on the Ready store card.

evidence.action: State 1 · First setup → select My ceramic plates → Connect store → Choose location → pick Warehouse in California → Save → Open Settings
evidence.observed: Store badge changes from 'Setup needed' to 'Ready'; the banner 'My ceramic plates needs setup before it receives changes. Show' is gone; Sync still shows 'State: Disabled' with the Enable button in the middle column (x≈593), separate from the store card (x≈932) where every previous step happened; no element on the card or banner mentions enabling.

gaps: Run now: only toasts, so what users see after a manual run (counts, Last sync update) is unknown
Failed events: no failed sample data, so the Failed state's message and recovery path could not be judged
Shopify install redirect: simulated by an in-page loader, so a cancelled/failed install (error state on return) was never reached
Second-store Connect store dialog: second_interaction=false in the state map; re-picking or cancelling inside the dialog not exercised

Automatic detection of 'Created product should be: Inventory': prototype sets it instantly on Open Settings, so the real waiting state (user changed it in another tab, page not yet updated) cannot be checked
Banner 'Show' only scrolls ~75px when the store card is already visible; behaviour with several stores needing setup (which store it targets) not exercised
Retry held and failed sent the held change while sync was Paused (toast '1 held change sent.', status Applied); whether Retry should respect Pause is a Domain question not judged here
